post.originalText:
Prompt:

​"A professional 8-panel storyboard infographic layout titled 'AVOCADO TRANSFORMATION' for a high-energy 15-second vertical commercial (9:16 aspect ratio). Clean dark background, vibrant green accents, modern typography, and high-end commercial food photography paired with clean technical storyboard sketches for each frame."

Detailed Scene Prompts for AI Video Generation

​Scene 01: The Cut (00:00 - 00:01.5)

​Prompt: Extreme macro close-up shot of a sharp knife slicing through a fresh, textured green avocado. Dramatic natural lighting, 100mm lens, fast knife cut tracking movement, high resolution, dynamic action shot.

​Scene 02: The Reveal (00:01.5 - 00:03)

​Prompt: Close-up shot of two halves of a fresh avocado opening up, revealing the smooth flesh and brown seed inside. Bright fresh studio lighting, 100mm lens, smooth pushing-in camera motion.

​Scene 03: The Scoop (00:03 - 00:04.5)

​Prompt: Macro slow-motion shot of a metal spoon smoothly scooping out bright green avocado flesh. Natural fresh lighting, 100mm lens, detailed texture of rich creamy avocado.

​Scene 04: The Drop (00:04.5 - 00:06)

​Prompt: Low-angle shot from inside a glass blender, slow-motion capture of fresh avocado chunks dropping in. Bright clean lighting, 50mm lens, dynamic upward perspective.

​Scene 05: The Collision (00:06 - 00:08)

​Prompt: Dynamic close-up of splash action as ice cubes and splash of fresh milk collide inside a glass blender container. Bright commercial studio lighting, high-speed camera, 50mm lens.

​Scene 06: The Vortex (00:08 - 00:10)

​Prompt: Top-down overhead shot inside a blender creating a swirling high-speed vortex of rich green avocado smoothie. Glossy, vibrant, bright lighting, 100mm macro lens, smooth 360^\circ orbital camera movement.

​Scene 07: The Transformation (00:10 - 00:12.5)

​Prompt: Extreme close-up shot of thick, creamy, velvety avocado smoothie texture being lifted with a spoon. Soft premium studio lighting, rich green colors, 100mm lens, smooth push-in slow motion.

​Scene 08: The Perfect Pour (00:12.5 - 00:15)

​Prompt: Hero commercial shot of a thick green avocado smoothie pouring smoothly into a tall clear glass, garnished with fresh mint on top. Warm appetizing commercial lighting, 85mm lens, 180^\circ slow orbit camera view.
